claims.claim: ASML Holding N.V. identity and NASDAQ:ASML tradability are corroborated by current issuer reporting and independent market-data lineage.

Q2 2026 issuer results, 2025 full-year issuer results and High-NA readiness disclosure are distinct primary documents from the same issuer origin; they are not counted as independent corroboration. StockAnalysis/S&P/Nasdaq-derived market data is retained only as independent valuation/tradability lineage.

unknowns.unknown: Exact customer-level EUV/High-NA order cancellation terms and 2028 realized output remain undisclosed/future execution evidence.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 net sales were EUR9.326B, gross margin 54.0%, net income EUR2.918B and end-quarter cash plus short-term investments EUR7.582B; management raised 2026 sales guidance to EUR43-45B and gross margin to 54-56%.
2025 net sales were EUR32.667B, gross margin 52.8%, net income EUR9.609B and year-end backlog EUR38.797B, providing a strong operating and order base entering 2026.

ASML stated AI-related Logic and Memory investment is translating into customer commitments and planned roughly 30% more low-NA EUV capacity for 2027 versus about 65 systems in 2026, while High-NA has reached production use at Intel.

At Sep. 17, 2026 ASML closed at $1,629.67 with approximately $625B market capitalization, 51.53 trailing P/E and 29.04 forward P/E; valuation therefore carries a high expectation burden despite exceptional bottleneck control.

thesisQuality.basis: Realized High-NA production use, strong 2025 backlog and accelerating 2026 AI-linked customer commitments directly corroborate the leading-edge lithography thesis.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 sales EUR9.326B, 54.0% gross margin and EUR2.918B net income followed 2025 sales growth to EUR32.667B and management raised 2026 guidance to EUR43-45B.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: A roughly $625B market cap, 51.53x trailing P/E and 29.04x forward P/E embed substantial execution expectations despite strong growth.

catalystScore.basis: Raised 2026 guidance, strong customer commitments, planned EUV capacity expansion and High-NA production qualification create identifiable conversion catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Large profitability, EUR7.582B quarter-end liquidity and ongoing shareholder returns support execution capacity; no current governance defect is evidenced in this packet.

alignment2036.basis: Leading-edge EUV/High-NA lithography is foundational equipment for advanced logic and memory scaling tied directly to AI compute growth.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: EUV, DUV, metrology/inspection and installed-base service/upgrade revenue reinforce one another across semiconductor production generations.

bottleneckControl.basis: ASML remains the unique commercial supplier of leading-edge EUV lithography, with High-NA moving into production use.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Logic, memory, installed-base service and multiple lithography generations diversify demand, while export controls and semiconductor capex cyclicality remain material external scenarios.

substitutionResilience.basis: No current commercial peer displaces ASML at leading-edge EUV; customer process alternatives exist but High-NA production qualification strengthens technical lock-in.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Strong liquidity and profitability provide financial resilience, but extreme system complexity and specialized supplier capacity remain meaningful throughput dependencies.

pricingPower.basis: Unique leading-edge lithography capability, strong commitments and sustained >50% gross margin support exceptional value capture, though exact system-level margins are undisclosed.

riskEvidence.basis: Principal risks are export-control/geopolitical market access, customer capex cyclicality, specialized supplier throughput, High-NA economics/adoption timing and a demanding valuation baseline.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current issuer financial results and technology-production evidence anchor operating and bottleneck claims; independent S&P/Nasdaq-derived market data anchors valuation. Exact future unit mix and cancellation economics remain explicit non-gating unknowns.
